workload: inspection.launch.py with Gazebo GUI, RViz and OptiX, stationary AGV
method: One sequential run per scene under the project-private patched Mesa and experimental OptiX runtime; whole-device VRAM includes the desktop.

static_validation.note: This includes full manifest hashes and OBJ/proxy validation and is not simulator load time.

conclusion: The material memory cost is negligible, but a 364672-triangle road collision mesh causes an unacceptable RTF regression. Preserve the 10 cm visual/OptiX height field and optimize its physics representation before full-region capture.
